>
[Elemental Existence](/Feats.aspx?ID=4378) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Stonebound](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=210)

**Prerequisites**
[Stonebound Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4377)

</column>

---

Your body becomes infused with elemental earth. You gain the [Adopted Ancestry](/Feats.aspx?ID=751) feat and gain a 1st level [oread ancestry feat](/Feats.aspx?Traits=304) as a bonus feat, ignoring the limitations of the [lineage](/Traits.aspx?ID=317) trait. When you gain new ancestry feats, you can select oread feats in addition to feats allowed by your ancestry and heritage.
